cases.description: Test case where the input key is null, expecting null since no higher entry can be found.
Test case where the input key exists in the trie, expecting the next entry after the found key.
Test case where the input key does not exist in the trie, and the root is empty, expecting the first entry in the trie.
Test case where the input key does not exist and has a valid bit index, expecting the next entry of a temporarily added entry.
Test case where the input key results in a null bit index, expecting the first entry or the next entry of the first entry.
Test case where the input key results in an equal bit index, expecting the next entry of the found key.
Test case where the input key results in an invalid lookup, expecting an IllegalStateException to be thrown.
Test case where the trie is empty and any key is provided, expecting null since there are no entries in the trie.
Test case where the input key is the largest key in the trie, expecting null since there is no higher entry.
Test case where the input key results in a negative bit index, expecting an IllegalStateException to be thrown due to invalid lookup.
Test case where the input key has the maximum possible bit index, expecting the next entry after the found key.
Test case where the input key differs by only one bit from an existing key, expecting the next entry after the found key.
Test case where the input key leads to a corrupted entry in the trie, expecting a ConcurrentModificationException due to modification during iteration.
